outlets.title: Outlets
outlets.staffNote: Outlet staff are linked to an outlet by its id. For now they are added with a database migration.
outlets.coordinateInvalid: Enter the coordinate as a number
outlets.imageInvalid: Enter a full web address, or leave it empty

detail.subtitle: The outlet's address, contact, location and photos.
detail.createSubtitle: Enter the new outlet's name, address, location and photos.
detail.editSubtitle: Change the outlet's name, address, location or photos.
detail.noBannerHint: Upload photos in the outlet's form and they will show here.

outlets.search: Search name, address, phone or email...
outlets.emptyDescription: Add the first outlet to start taking orders there.

form.locationDescription: Where it is on the map. Copy the coordinates from a map app, e.g. -6.2088 and 106.8456.
form.bannerDescription: The photos customers see for this outlet; the first one is the main photo. Leave empty if there are none.
form.addressPlaceholder: e.g. Jl. Boulevard Raya No. 12, Jakarta Utara
form.dragImage: Drag photo {{n}} to change its place
form.closeHint: A closing time earlier than the opening time means the outlet closes after midnight, for example 22:00 to 02:00.
form.deliveryRequired: Choose at least one: pick up, delivery, or both
form.timesEqual: The opening and closing times cannot be the same
form.fileType: Only JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF pictures
form.limitReached: The limit of {{max}} photos is reached
form.dropRules: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF · up to 5 MB each · {{count}} of {{max}} photos
form.reorderHint: Drag to reorder; the first photo is the main photo.
form.sortInstructions: Press space to pick up a photo, the arrow keys to move it, and space again to drop it.
form.serviceDescription: What the outlet sells and how orders reach the customer.
form.activeDescription: An active outlet shows in the customer app. Switch it off to hide it without deleting anything.
form.phoneInvalid: Use digits, spaces and + - ( ), 6 to 20 characters

outlets.subtitle: Manage the outlets, their address and contact, and whether each is open for business.

map.label: Map of the outlets
map.pickHint: Click the map or drag the pin to set the location

hours.deliveryHint: Choose one or both ways customers can use this outlet.

delivery.pickupDesc: Customers bring their laundry to the outlet and collect it there.
delivery.deliveryDesc: A courier collects and returns the laundry at the customer's address.

staff.empty: No staff assigned to this outlet yet.

picker.noResults: No place found. Try other words, or put the pin on the map.
picker.searchFailed: The address search is not available now. Put the pin on the map instead.
picker.geoUnsupported: This browser cannot tell where you are.
picker.geoDenied: Location access was blocked. Allow it for this site in the browser, or pick the place on the map.
picker.geoUnavailable: Your position could not be found. Pick the place on the map.
picker.geoTimeout: Finding your position took too long. Try again.
picker.mapLabel: Move the map: the pin stays in the middle and marks the location. Click the map to center on a point.
picker.pinLabel: Location pin, fixed at the centre of the map. Use the arrow keys on the map to nudge it by about 10 metres, Shift for 100 metres.
picker.gesturesWindows: Use Ctrl + scroll to zoom the map
picker.gesturesMac: Use ⌘ + scroll to zoom the map
picker.gesturesMobile: Use two fingers to move the map
picker.noPin: No pin yet. Search for an address, use your location, or click the map.
picker.dragHint: Move the map to set the location

schedule.title: Opening hours

schedule.timezoneHint: Every time below is in this zone.
schedule.copyMonday: Apply Monday's hours to all days
schedule.tzNoPin: Set the location on the map and the zone is detected.
schedule.quickHint: Fill the whole week in one click.
